title: Hook activation record (schema 1)
description: Per-project, per-host record of who owns each hook and what was observed before the decision was made. Deliberately NOT `.claude/.starter-sync.json → migrated_config`: that ledger records a concrete configuration identity that was removed and replaced, and `recordMigration` writes nothing when there is none — which is precisely the first rollout project's case (the plugin already owns the hook and no legacy entry ever existed). `evidence` names an observation file that must exist; `previous` carries whole registration objects and a byte copy of the legacy script, because a checksum can verify a restored file but cannot supply one after the original is deleted.

evidence.description: Repo-relative path to the observation file. A free-text label is not evidence; the gate checks the path exists.

previous.description: null when no legacy entry existed to replace — a valid state, not an error.

registrations.description: Whole settings.json hook entries, never identity strings: a rollback restores these verbatim.

snapshot_path.description: Byte-for-byte copy kept under .agents/hooks/snapshots/. The hash proves a restoration is exact; only this copy can supply a downstream's customized bytes once the original is deleted.
